name: spoken-alerts
description: Speaks two alerts with Mac, OpenAI or ElevenLabs voices: when work ends, the project, the thread and what was done; when Claude asks you something, a chime, the question and the recommended option.

provider.title: Voice provider
provider.description: mac speaks with the Mac's own voices (free, offline). openai and elevenlabs need that provider's API key; if the cloud voice fails, the Mac voice speaks.

macDoneVoice.title: Mac work-done voice
macDoneVoice.description: A Mac voice name, as `say -v '?'` lists them.

macQuestionVoice.title: Mac question voice
macQuestionVoice.description: A Mac voice name. The Mac voices also speak when a cloud voice fails.

openaiDoneVoice.title: OpenAI work-done voice
openaiDoneVoice.description: alloy, ash, ballad, cedar, coral, echo, fable, marin, nova, onyx, sage, shimmer or verse.

openaiQuestionVoice.title: OpenAI question voice
openaiQuestionVoice.description: An OpenAI voice name, as for the work-done voice.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API key
openaiApiKey.description: Needed for the openai provider. Kept in secure storage. Empty: OPENAI_API_KEY from the environment, then from ~/.claude/.env.

elevenlabsDoneVoice.title: ElevenLabs work-done voice
elevenlabsDoneVoice.description: A voice ID from your ElevenLabs voice library. The default is the stock voice Sarah.

elevenlabsQuestionVoice.title: ElevenLabs question voice
elevenlabsQuestionVoice.description: A voice ID from your ElevenLabs voice library. The default is the stock voice George.

elevenlabsApiKey.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabsApiKey.description: Needed for the elevenlabs provider. Kept in secure storage. Empty: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY from the environment, then from ~/.claude/.env.
